# Results (generated by experiment/analyze.py, do not edit by hand)

Every estimate is a shift in the weekly gap between a segment and the rest of the city, after vs before the toll's calendar date, shown as a percent. See ANALYSIS_PLAN.md.

## Data
- Seasons: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 (start year). Weeks per season: 37 (12 before the toll date, 1 transition week left out, 24 after).
- Trips in the comparison window, millions:

| Season | Inside the zone | Into or out of the zone | Manhattan outside the zone | Rest of city |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2022-23 | 38.6 | 39.0 | 25.8 | 80.1 |
| 2023-24 | 38.5 | 39.3 | 27.0 | 86.5 |
| 2024-25 | 38.7 | 39.4 | 27.9 | 91.1 |
| 2025-26 | 37.4 | 39.1 | 29.1 | 100.2 |

- Mix-adjusted speed uses cells that cover 100% of timed miles (all seasons) inside the zone and 90% in the rest of the city.

## Average speed in mph (mix-adjusted), January-June weeks
| Season | Inside the zone | Rest of city |
|---|---|---|
| 2022-23 | 8.79 | 14.25 |
| 2023-24 | 8.43 | 13.89 |
| 2024-25 | 8.66 | 13.78 |
| 2025-26 | 8.03 | 13.34 |

## Primary: speed inside the zone (mix-adjusted, all hours)
| | Toll year (2024-25 vs 2023-24) | 95% CI | Placebo year (2023-24 vs 2022-23) | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Speed inside the zone | +3.5% | [+1.3%, +5.7%] | +1.8% | [+0.4%, +3.1%] |

- Decision rule from the plan: placebo is 51% the size of the main estimate (ABOVE the 50% line).
- Smallest shift this design would reliably detect (2.8 x standard error): 3.0%.

## Second toll season (2025-26 vs 2023-24), description only
Average gap over the same January-June weeks, minus the pre-toll gap from autumn 2024.
- Speed inside the zone: -0.9% (first toll season, same weeks: +3.5%)
- Trips inside the zone: -14.1% (first toll season, same weeks: +0.6%)
- Trips into or out of the zone: -12.4% (first toll season, same weeks: -0.5%)
